# meraki_generate_appliance_vmx_authentication_token (Action)

This action can invoke the `Generate Appliance vMX Authentication Token` operation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "meraki_generate_appliance_vmx_authentication_token" "example" {
  config {
    serial = "1234-ABCD-1234"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `serial` (String) Device serial
